report.clinical_summary: Patient with CLL for 5 years, currently not on active treatment and in monitoring phase with routine blood tests every 3 months. Presents with increased fatigue over past couple of weeks and new neck lump (1 week). Lump does not hurt or itch. Patient has good understanding of condition, trusts hematologist, and is generally not very worried. Engaged in self-monitoring by staying informed and asking questions. Wants to feel more in control through lifestyle factors.
